title: Platforms Overview
meta_description: Eight proprietary platforms — Nexus, Forge, Swarm, Sentinel, Twinverse, Quanta, Ledger, Compass — encoding a decade of deep-tech delivery into configura.

blocks.x: Eight proprietary platforms encode a decade of deep-tech delivery as configurable products.

Platforms are how DataQ Soft turns consulting into leverage: governance, security posture, evidence generation and delivery patterns arrive pre-built. Clients start at pattern 80% and finish with systems their auditors can inspect.

items: Enterprise decisions in milliseconds — with the evidence to defend every one.
DataQ Forge — Data & Lakehouse Engineering Platform
The governed data estate every intelligence program silently depends on.
DataQ Swarm — Agentic AI Orchestration Platform
Hundreds of agents as one governed, measurable workforce.
DataQ Sentinel — Zero-Trust & AI Security Platform
Security architecture you can evidence — for humans, machines and models.
DataQ Twinverse — Digital Twin & IoT Intelligence Platform
Sense, simulate, act — the operations stack for physical assets.
DataQ Quanta — Quantum & Advanced Compute Suite
Emerging compute with investor discipline — baselines, benchmarks, verdicts.
DataQ Ledger — Distributed Trust & Tokenization Platform
Shared truth with regulatory teeth — permissioned networks that survive supervision.
DataQ Compass — Responsible AI & Governance Platform
AI your model-risk committee approves and your regulator can inspect.

blocks.x: How platforms are used in engagements

Most programs combine two or three platforms: a decision program lands Nexus on Forge rails; an agentic program lands Swarm under Compass governance; an industrial program lands Twinverse with Sentinel segmentation. Each platform page carries Overview, Architecture & Trust and Industry Use Cases.
Explore a platform — or book a technical briefing with the platform team.
